signature: A small furnished room with a puddled carpet, built sideways into the concrete ceiling of an endless dim ocean: the doorway shows the sea face-on, gravity turns toward it, and a rope ladder is the only way back up from the water 4.5 m below.

exits.label: Swam into the underwater cave in the side of the seamount
exits.source_quote: underwater cave on the side of a particularly tall mountain toward the bottom of the Midnight Zone
exits.hint: The mountain stands almost straight below the doorway. Far down, past where the light ends, the water is being drawn into its flank.

exits.label: Opened the wooden door in the floor of the stone platform
exits.source_quote: a wooden door built into the floor of a circular stone platform
exits.hint: West of the doorway and well below the surface, massive pipes and pillars stand in a ring. Something lives there that hears everything.

exits.label: Blacked out in the Abyss
exits.source_quote: diving into the Abyss and going unconscious leads directly to Level 83
exits.hint: Nobody has lasted much more than two minutes in the deepest water.

entity_policy: Two CONFIRMED entities as presences only: the page never describes what Tiny or the Thing look like, so neither has a body. Tiny: confined to the Daylight and Twilight Zones, concentrated at his ring; strong hearing (fast swimming is loud; striking a rusted pipe is a loud noise that subdues him). The Thing: Midnight Zone and upper Abyss; light-sensitive eyes (flashlight subdues it). Neither leaves its zone (their mutual agreement). No other life: skeletons only. Fort Surrender worshippers are RUMORED and are not spawned; their tar-and-furniture shelter stands empty.
notes: ADAPTATION: depth compressed for play: Daylight 0-180 m, Twilight 180-320 m, Midnight 320-500 m, Abyss below 500 m (page: twilight ~1 km, midnight ~4 km, abyss >7 km); the cave mouth sits at ~470 m on the seamount's east ridge and the Level 9 platform keeps the page's ~150 m west / ~150 m down. Breath capacity 450 s (page: almost 30 minutes in some cases), scaled with the compressed depths. The entrance room is walkable in its own frame; the doorway shows the sea face-on and a sideways copy of the room is visible through the ceiling hatch from the water. The coiled rope ladder by the doorframe is an ADAPTATION (the page says a rope or ladder is essential; we leave one for the player to tie). Stairs up to Level 6 end in total darkness: no documented route back up. Islands, abyss piles and bone scatter are seeded; the seamount, hatch, ring, cave and Fort Surrender are authored. Playable world is a finite streaming window (150 m ceiling/abyss chunks); the ocean volume spans 12 km. QA FIXTURE: in QA mode only, a copy of the Level 9 floor door is placed in the entrance-room floor and the deep exits are not built; the real dive and door routes are verified by levels/L007/route_test.gd. Dev6: new inbound provisional start-position aliases (from_L007_7) are not custom-designed entrance geometry.
